data.title: Team Lead Onboarding Session
data.summary: Session where new team lead learned Seven Pillars, read accumulated wisdom from samples, merged main branch (CDG), and began dogfooding

sections.Key Learnings: 1. Seven Pillars: CDG (foundation), PRISM, CEL, GoT, Woven Mind, Spark, QAPV. 2. samples/memories/ contains accumulated wisdom. 3. Edge density improved from 0.01 to 1.38 edges/node. 4. Dogfooding works - system tests itself. 5. Dragons are real - recursive self-reference can be pathological. 6. Stop planning, start doing.
sections.What Changed: Merged main branch (135 commits): CDG module added (3,551 lines), 69,238 total insertions, KT lifecycle formalized, Trust But Verify section added to CLAUDE.md. Created: CLAUDE.md.you (252 lines - focused on Seven Pillars), cognitive_bootstrap.py (self-referential identity tool), COGNITIVE_ARCHITECTURE_PSEUDOCODE.md (visual system relationships).
sections.Next Instance Should: 1. Run python scripts/cognitive_bootstrap.py --quick first. 2. Read samples/memories/ before planning. 3. Create edges, not just tasks. 4. Dogfood - use the system to improve itself. 5. Read the accumulated wisdom in KT-20260102-094853.
sections.Dogfooding Results: Ran all test suites for blocking tasks. All 27 tests now pass. Completed 6 tasks: T-20260101-211034-cf2f7c35 (cognitive loop), T-20260101-211037-944ff744 (woven mind), T-20260101-211039-5fd0380b (pubsub), T-20260101-211042-d6b94050 (transactions), T-20260101-211044-c5dd752d (task queries), T-20260101-211052-ffa58466 (CRITICAL: test health blocker). Tests were already passing after merge - just needed verification and task completion.
